resources.string: TwinSpace creates a secure, isolated workspace so you can run a second copy of any app — separate account, separate data. No root needed.

Your device already has a work profile that was not created by TwinSpace (for example, a built-in app-clone feature). TwinSpace can only manage its own work space. Remove that existing work profile from Settings → Accounts, then reopen TwinSpace.
Nothing cloned yet. Open the Personal tab and clone an app.
To remove the work profile: Settings → Accounts → remove the work profile.
